card: Preview macOS cleanup before choosing it.
title: macleanup before deletion
intro: macleanup takes the same cautious approach to a Mac: inspect the proposed cleanup before choosing anything to remove.

sections.heading: What does macleanup maintain?
sections.body: It handles macOS cleanup and maintenance with a cautious default.

sections.heading: How is cleanup previewed?
sections.body: The section catalogue lets you see the proposed work first.

sections.heading: Which folders stay out of reach?
sections.body: Personal folders are refused outright, regardless of the cleanup choice.

sections.heading: Where does macleanup fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps a personal record. macleanup looks at files a Mac can clear and refuses to take personal folders with them.
